name: Pauta & Takeaways Notes
description: A template focusing on comparing planned agenda vs. actually discussed topics, with clear key takeaways.

sections.title: Pauta Planejada
sections.instruction: Outline the topics originally intended or proposed to be covered in the meeting.

sections.title: Assuntos Abordados
sections.instruction: Detail the main points, responses, and outcomes for each topic discussed.

sections.title: Desvios de Pauta
sections.instruction: List any skipped agenda items or new/unplanned topics introduced during the conversation.

sections.title: Principais Takeaways
sections.instruction: Summarize the high-value insights, takeaways, decisions, or strategic alignment points in bullet format.

sections.title: Ações Imediatas
sections.instruction: List all immediate tasks assigned, owners, and agreed deadline checkpoints.
